title: Guard notify-parent when parent token is absent
objective: Fix notify-parent workflow so a missing PARENT_REPO_PAT secret is surfaced as an explicit warning/skip instead of a red failed check on every master push.
acceptance_criteria: notify-parent.yml checks whether PARENT_REPO_PAT is configured before invoking repository-dispatch.
Missing token produces an explicit GitHub Actions warning and skips dispatch without failing unrelated verification.
Workflow YAML parses and local focused tests remain green.
